title: EPILOGUE // BEASTS OF THE SHIVERING SEA
narrative: The leviathans summoned from the abyss swim north, shattering the ice sheets of the Shivering Sea. Coastlines flood and kingdoms drown as the ocean claims what was always its own. What is dead may never die, but rises again with harder, colder fury.
